meals.title: Boerewors with Pap and Tomato Sous
meals.why: Traditional boerewors is on special at Checkers (R89.99/kg with loyalty card), and a 10kg bag of maize meal makes pap very cheap per serving.
method: Fry the chopped onion in oil until soft, then add the chopped tomatoes, tomato paste, a pinch of sugar, salt and pepper. Simmer for 15 minutes until thick.
Bring salted water to the boil and stir in the maize meal in a steady stream. Cover and cook on low for 25-30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until crumbly or stiff.
Braai the boerewors over medium coals for 15-20 minutes, turning often.
Serve the wors with pap and the tomato sous.

meals.title: Butternut Curry with Rice and Chutney
meals.why: Butternut is only R14.99/kg and goes a long way in a filling vegetarian curry with parboiled rice.
method: Fry the chopped onion and garlic in oil, then stir in the curry powder and a teaspoon of paprika for 1 minute.
Add the cubed butternut and the chopped tomatoes with half a can of water. Simmer covered for 20-25 minutes until the butternut is tender.
Stir in a spoonful of chutney and season with salt.
Cook the rice according to the packet.
Serve the curry over the rice with extra chutney on the side.

meals.title: Quick Chicken Livers on Toast
meals.why: Frozen chicken livers are R21.50 for 500g, which makes this one of the cheapest protein dinners you can get this week.
also_need: thaw livers in the fridge the night before
method: Pat the thawed livers dry and season with paprika, salt and pepper.
Fry the sliced onion and garlic in a hot pan until golden, then push to the side.
Add the livers and sear for 3-4 minutes, turning once.
Stir in the tomato paste with a splash of water, and chilli if using. Simmer for 5 minutes until the livers are just cooked through and the sauce is glossy.
Toast the bread and spoon the livers over it.

meals.title: Cape Malay-Style Bobotie
meals.why: PnP bulk lean beef mince is R99.99, and bobotie stretches it with bread, milk and eggs. Both the milk (R29.99 with a loyalty card) and the eggs (R59.99 with a loyalty card) are on special at Checkers.

uses.item: PnP Live Well Bulk Lean Beef Mince

method: Heat the oven to 180°C. Soak 2 slices of bread in about 1 cup of milk, then squeeze out and keep the milk.
Fry the onion in oil, add the mince and brown it. Stir in the curry powder, turmeric, chutney, a splash of vinegar, raisins and the soaked bread.
Press the mixture into a baking dish.
Beat 2 eggs with the leftover milk and a pinch of salt, pour over the top and lay a bay leaf on it.
Bake for 35-40 minutes until the topping is set and golden.
Serve with rice and extra chutney.

meals.title: Sticky Pork Chops with Fries and Cucumber-Yoghurt Salad
meals.why: PnP pork braai chops are R64.99, and a brown sugar and paprika rub gives them a braai flavour in a pan or on the grill. The oven fries and cucumber salad keep the cooking simple.

uses.item: Double Cream Greek Style Yoghurt 1 KG

method: Mix 1 tbsp brown sugar with 2 tsp paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper. Rub it over the chops and rest them for 10 minutes.
Bake the fries on a tray at 220°C for 20-25 minutes, turning halfway.
Cook the chops in a hot pan or on a grill for 4-5 minutes per side until caramelised and cooked through.
Mix the diced cucumber with a few spoonfuls of Greek yoghurt, lemon juice, salt and herbs.
Serve the chops with the fries and salad.

meals.title: Paprika Chicken and Butternut Traybake
meals.why: The 5kg frozen braaipack works out cheap per portion, and butternut is at R14.99/kg. Cook half the pack now and freeze the rest in meal-sized bags.
also_need: thaw chicken in the fridge the day before
method: Heat the oven to 200°C. Toss the thawed chicken pieces with oil, paprika, garlic, salt and pepper.
Cube the butternut and slice the onion, then spread them in a roasting tray and nestle the chicken on top.
Roast for 45-50 minutes, turning once, until the chicken is golden and cooked through.
Brush the chicken with a little chutney for the last 10 minutes.
Serve straight from the tray.
